# Zeroing

> Zeroing is a community of homegrown, made-in-India brands based in New Delhi. Brands stand together like stalls in one lane: they open doors for each other, share customers and suppliers, and each sells from its own shop. Zeroing also runs Independent Society, a long-form podcast about working life in India, and The Other Details, a research lab that traces every number it publishes to its source.

## Brands
- [INDSO](https://zeroingnow.com/brands/indso): Botanical skincare, made in India. Shop: https://indso.in.
- [Ampor Eyewear](https://zeroingnow.com/brands/ampor-eyewear): Eyewear, made in India. Shop: https://ampor.in.
- [Vedi Kade](https://zeroingnow.com/brands/vedi-kade): Modern clothing that carries Tamil history.
- [Syzygy Living](https://zeroingnow.com/brands/syzygy-living): Design homeware.

## Notes
- Zeroing does not sell products itself and takes no payment.
- Claims about how brands make things are labelled by how far they have been checked.
